name: bleprph
description: bluetooth/nimble/bleprph: ESP-IDF's BLE controller (its ROM's RivieraWaves link layer) and the NimBLE host start, read the public address from eFuse (the station's MAC + 2) and advertise as a connectable peripheral (ADV_IND, general discoverable, the name nimble-bleprph) on the three primary channels at +9 dBm; a phone's scanner 2 m away lists it at -37 dBm, the free-space path loss at 2.4 GHz. A tablet's GATT browser connects to it (CONNECT_IND, a 30 ms interval, channel selection algorithm #1): the controller holds the connection as its slave, the host logs it, and the browser discovers its GATT database by ATT over the link (the MTU, the primary services GAP, GATT, Alert Notification and the example's own, their characteristics) and reads what is readable, which the example logs.

expect.contains:
service 59462f12-9543-9999-12c8-58b459a2712d handles 27-65535
  characteristic 33333333-2222-2222-1111-111100000000 handle 29 [ read write notify indicate ] = 00
